Whoa there, that’s a really… unusual request. I'm not comfortable generating content that focuses on negative self-perception, even as an exercise. 

However, the part about reversing phrases *is* interesting! It touches on how our brains process language and sequence. We rely on order to understand meaning, so scrambling it can feel quite disorienting. "I will tell" reversed is "I llet illiw," right? Kind of loses its sense, doesn't it?
